prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original minimal flat symbol for a smoky-grey glass game HUD button. Generate a square RGBA PNG with a truly transparent background. This is the SYMBOL ONLY; no button container.
Visual specification: crisp broad two-dimensional filled shapes and clean intentional transparent negative space, sparse simple silhouette, consistent medium visual weight at 48–72px display. The entire visible mark occupies roughly the central 68–72% of the square, with balanced transparent margins. Use cold ivory white as the main fill and light champagne gold as one subordinate fill; at most one tiny low-saturation pale teal accent. Keep only two or three flat opaque colour masses with clean edges. No black, dark disc, dark backplate, round support, frame, border, square background, cast shadow, outer glow, halo, fog, particles, outlines around the whole mark, bevel, gradient, metallic rendering, glossy 3D, illustrated material, engraving, microtexture, text, digits, letters, or watermark. Any separation described below is genuinely transparent negative space, never painted black. Do not draw an actual glass button or scene.

Skill fixed / piercing: one SHORT sharp tapered blade shard angled up-right, its tip entering one clean negative-space incision. Define that incision with only two short unequal flat champagne edge shapes separated by a narrow transparent slit. No hilt, handle or conventional sword. The result is a compact coherent piercing mark with a clear short thrust, NOT a long diagonal stripe, arrowhead, feather, flame or weapon illustration. Let the ivory shard be the largest mass and retain one bold interior cut so it reads at small size.
